task:
MuseScore 3 is already open with the file /home/user/Documents/piano_only.mscz. The score currently has one part: Piano.

Add a Flute instrument so the final score has exactly two parts.

1. Press the keyboard shortcut I (or use Edit > Instruments...) to open the Instruments dialog.
2. In the instrument list, find Woodwinds > Flute.
3. Click Add to add the Flute to the current score. The new Flute staff should appear in the instrument list on the right side.
4. Click OK to close the dialog.
5. Save the file with Ctrl+S.

The saved score must have exactly 2 parts: the original Piano and the newly added Flute. The file must remain at /home/user/Documents/piano_only.mscz.

verification.description: Flute instrument exists in the score
Piano instrument still exists in the score

cli_feasibility.translation: cli-anything-musescore instruments add -i /home/user/Documents/piano_only.mscz -o /home/user/Documents/piano_only.mscz --id 'flute' --name 'Flute' && cli-anything-musescore project save -i /home/user/Documents/piano_only.mscz -o /home/user/Documents/piano_only.mscz
